problem: Find the angle between $a=⟨7,2⟩$ and $b=⟨0,6⟩.$ Round your answer to $1$ decimal place.
worked_solution:
Rearranging the dot product formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,a\,||\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}}\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{7\cdot 0+2\cdot 6}{\sqrt{{7}^{2}+{2}^{2}}\sqrt{{0}^{2}+{6}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{12}{\sqrt{53}\cdot \sqrt{36}} \\  & =\frac{2}{\sqrt{53}}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\theta =\operatorname{arccos}⁡(\frac{2}{\sqrt{53}})≈{74.1}^{∘}.
$$
